goal: For any probability law μ on finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel E and η>0, construct an actual measurable Markov kernel R with R(y)=μ.tilted(x↦−‖x−y‖²/(2η)) at every y, and prove that R disintegrates the swapped actual law of (X,X+sqrt(η)G), with independent X~μ and standard Gaussian G.
